rationale: The bundle supports only a conditional explanation: Cobra adds the top-level `--version` flag when the root command’s `Version` is set (`site/content/user_guide.md:590-592`), and initialization does nothing if `c.Version` is empty or a version flag already exists (`command.go:1202-1204`). It does not show the application’s root command configuration, so the candidate’s definitive claim that its `Version` field “was not set” is unsupported. The statement that `--version` “only exists” when `Version` is non-empty is also too broad because the preserved evidence explicitly allows an already-defined version flag.
